dialogues.speaker: Ariana
dialogues.text: Yeah. Curry is one thing that everyone in Sumeru knows how to cook.

dialogues.speaker: Ariana
dialogues.text: Its flavor varies from family to family because every family has their own curry recipe.

dialogues.speaker: Ariana
dialogues.text: But most of their curry tastes great.

dialogues.speaker: Ariana
dialogues.text: So, would you like to have a taste of my recipe?
